# Sonnatt.ai

> Sonnatt.ai gets UK small businesses into AI, set up and run by a real person. Every client has their own account manager who audits the business, plans what AI will help, builds it and runs it every month: websites, AI chatbots, online bookings, follow-ups and reviews, social media, AI receptionists and custom apps. Based in Leeds, West Yorkshire, working with businesses across the whole UK (England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland), mostly remotely.

## Key facts (prices include VAT)
- AI advice line: £39 a month. A phone number to call a Sonnatt.ai adviser about AI or any AI question. No other Sonnatt.ai service needed.
- Starter: £99 a month + £199 setup, 12-month plan. 5-page website, AI chatbot 24/7, leads to your inbox, Google Business Profile set up, hosting and monthly updates.
- Growth: £499 a month + £499 setup, 6-month plan. Everything in Starter plus AI audit and plan, online bookings and reminders, automatic follow-ups and review requests, 12 social posts a month, quarterly reviews.
- Pro (recommended): £995 a month + £995 setup, cancel any time. Everything in Growth plus a custom website, chatbot connected to your systems, customer system (CRM) and mobile app, follow-ups by email and text, 20 social posts a month plus replies, growth campaign, monthly reviews, priority support.
- Scale: from £3,000 a month, custom setup after discovery. Everything in Pro plus AI receptionist, multiple sites, custom AI assistants and apps, managed ads, senior account manager, same-day support.
- Add-ons: AI receptionist £149/month; AI presenter videos £199/month; paid ads management £249/month (ad spend extra); extra social posts £99/month; email newsletter £79/month; business number and texts £29/month; logo and brand kit £249 one-off; custom app or dashboard from £1,500.
- How it works: 1 Audit, 2 Discover (plain-English AI plan), 3 Implement, 4 Run and grow. Starts with a free 15-minute call.
- AI tools used: Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot, Meta AI, Grok, Mistral, Perplexity, Midjourney, ElevenLabs and others, chosen per business. Sonnatt.ai is independent and not affiliated with these companies.
- Who it is for: trades and contractors, property and lettings, clinics, salons, gyms and hospitality, professional services such as accountants and solicitors.
- Contact: info@sonnattai.com. Book a free 15-minute call at https://sonnattai.com/#book.
- The presenter "Emma" in the site's introduction video is AI-generated. The website chat assistant answers from Sonnatt.ai's published facts; bookings and enquiries go to the team by email.

## Guides
- [How much does a small business website cost in Leeds?](https://sonnattai.com/guides/small-business-website-cost-leeds/): A small business website has two costs: the one-off build and the ongoing cost of keeping it running, which covers hosting, security updates, changes and the marketing that brings people to it.
- [Does my small business need a website chatbot?](https://sonnattai.com/guides/does-my-business-need-a-website-chatbot/): A website chatbot is worth having if people regularly ask you the same questions, contact you outside working hours, or leave your site without getting in touch.
- [How to set up and optimise your Google Business Profile](https://sonnattai.com/guides/google-business-profile-guide/): Your Google Business Profile is the box that appears on Google Search and Maps when people look for your business or for what you do nearby.
- [Website vs social media: which does a small business need?](https://sonnattai.com/guides/website-vs-social-media-small-business/): Most small businesses need both, because they do different jobs.
- [How to get more Google reviews (without breaking Google's rules)](https://sonnattai.com/guides/how-to-get-more-google-reviews/): The way to get more Google reviews is to ask every happy customer, at the right moment, with a direct link that makes it take seconds.
- [What to put on your website so customers get in touch](https://sonnattai.com/guides/what-to-put-on-a-small-business-website/): A small business website should answer the questions customers have before they contact you, and make contacting you easy.
- [What should an accountant's website include?](https://sonnattai.com/guides/what-should-an-accountants-website-include/): An accountant's website should make it obvious which clients you work with and what you do for them, give an idea of fees, and show why people can trust you: qualifications, professional body membership, real reviews and the people behind the firm.
